name: 3W Clinic Collagen Foam Cleansing 100ml - Face Wash | Korea
description:
Brand:3w Clinic 


Made in Korea 


Skin Type:All skin types 


Size:100ml 


– A relieving facial foam wash. 


– Features a hypoallergenic, non-drying formula. 


– Creates a rich lather to dissolve makeup residue & remove impurities & dead cells. 


– Contains collagen to relieve skin irritation & protect it from roughness. 


– Leaves skin soft, calm, clean & moist. 


How to use: 


1. Put considerable amount to build up soft and creamy lather and apply the foaming cleanser with fingertips in circular motion. 


2. Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water. 


Ingredients: 


Water, Potassium Hydroxide, Lauric Acid, Myristic Acid, Glycerin, Lauramide DEA, Glyceryl Stearate, Phenoxyethanol, Methylparaben, Propylparaben, Disodium EDTA, Sorbitan Olivate, Rosa Hybrid Flower Water(0.1%), Freesia Refracta Extract, PEG-100Stearate, Galactomyces Ferment Filtrate, Oryza Sativa (Rice) Extract 


#FaceWash
